statements.query: UPDATE orders SET updated_at = updated_at + interval $1 WHERE id % $2 = $3

SELECT c.oid, c.relkind, c.reltuples, obj_description(c.oid, $3) AS comment,
                  has_table_privilege(c.oid, $4) AS can_select,
                  pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_bytes, pg_table_size(c.oid) AS table_bytes,
                  pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS indexes_bytes, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes
             FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 AND c.relkind IN ($5,$6,$7,$8,$9)
